expected_symptom: Design question with no compiler-observable repro; checkable fact is whether ID3D12FunctionReflection1/GetDesc1 (or equivalent node-property exposure) exists on main.
godbolt_skip: pure API/design question (extend reflection COM interfaces vs. design a new RDAT-surfacing API); no shader exists whose compilation would demonstrate more or less reflection-API surface, and CE cannot exercise a COM reflection interface at all
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Maintainer-filed design question (not a bug): should the ID3D12LibraryReflection/ID3D12FunctionReflection COM interfaces be extended to expose Work Graph node-shader launch mode/node ID, or should a more general RDAT-surfacing API be designed instead. On main (89e2f98e2), ID3D12FunctionReflection1/GetDesc1/D3D12_FUNCTION_DESC1 do not exist anywhere in the repo; CFunctionReflection::GetDesc only fills Version/ConstantBuffers/BoundResources and never reads DxilFunctionProps::NodeProps or NodeShaderID, though that data is already computed and serialized into RDAT internally. PR #6827 is an open, unreviewed attempt at exactly this and still needs a DirectX-Headers change. Both outstanding questions remain unresolved; no shader repro can settle an API-design decision.
title: [SM 6.8] Reflection for Work Graph nodes plus more general DXIL Library reflection
